note: Twenty-five pages, 55 measured regions: 25 page-foot WeChat stamps and 30 exhibit regions, a clean partition with no duplicate exclusion. The exhibits are 27 figures - Figures 1 to 27 with no gaps - and 3 tables, and all thirty regions measure completely, so the paper declares no gap. Every figure caption is the bare two-word label 'Figure N' with no title, printing below the raster, while all three tables print their caption above a closed boxed grid with a vertical rule between every column. All 27 figures are single embedded rasters with no selectable text; the three tables are 13, 13 and 37 vector paths. Fourteen families' worth of chart design in fact reduce to a handful of templates re-run per country or industry: three packed-bubble country charts (Figures 7 to 9) with no size key, two world maps (10 and 13), a matched pair of three-bar percentage-change charts (20 and 22), a matched pair of six-series country output plots (17 and 18), and two network diagrams (2 and 3) carrying the model's own architecture. Beyond that: 9 line, 4 bar, 4 scatter, 4 flowchart-or-schematic, 2 map-or-plan-view, 2 table-as-figure, 1 node-link-network, 1 surface-or-3D and 3 table-grid. No heatmap, no colorbar except Figure 10's two-label ramp. Ten figures and two tables are never cited. The closing pages hold no exhibit.
rules: Caption side is uniform and kind-driven in this paper: every one of the twenty-seven figures prints its caption BELOW the raster and all three tables print theirs ABOVE the grid, so [caption.position] is 'below' on every item row and 'above' on every table row - Table 1's caption at y75.0 over a grid starting at 98.0, Table 2's at y212.7 over 235.8, Table 3's at y75.0 over 98.0, and Figure 19's at y438.7 under a box ending at 425.3.

Every figure caption in this paper is the bare label 'Figure N' with no title - twenty-seven captions, not one of them more than two words - so no row carries a [caption.words] count above 2 and no caption states a unit, an axis meaning or a conclusion.

Seven captions print glued to the preceding word in the text layer ('dels Figure1', 'MATHmode Figure4', 'odels Figure7', 'odels Figure8', 'odels Figure13', 'models Figure19', 'models Figure24'), where the digit touches the label and no space survives, so those rows quote the whole raw line under [caption.verbatim] and the banner glyph run rides along with the two printed words; the numbering is overridden to 'Figure N' because 'Figure 1' never parses out of 'Figure1'. Three further labels only collide with the preceding word ('ApplicationFigure 16', 'experienceFigure 20', 'distanceFigure 25') and still contain a spaced 'Figure N', so those three quote the bare label as printed.

Section assignment follows printed order and the nearest preceding heading, and the paper's numbering skips: the printed headings run 1, 1.1, 2, 2.1, 2.1.1, 2.1.2, 2.1.3, 2.1.4, 2.2, 2.3, 2.3.1, 2.4, 3, 4, 4.1, 4.1.1, 4.1.2, 4.3, 4.3.1, 4.3.2, 4.3.3, 4.3.4, 5, 5.1, 6 and 6.2, so [place.section_path] names 2.1.2 for Figures 5 to 7 and 2.1.3 for Figures 8 and 9, even though the single-problem prose reads continuously.

Every measured exhibit region in this paper is either one embedded raster image (all twenty-seven figures, each a single image path with no selectable text, so no in-figure label can be quoted from the text layer) or one small vector grid (the three tables, 13, 13 and 37 paths), so no multi-panel figure needs a duplicate exclusion anywhere: [geometry.panel_count] is 1 on every row.

The three tables are reported as [table.rule_style] 'vertical-rules': each is a closed box with a rule on all four sides and a vertical rule between every column, the opposite of the booktabs grids of the previous papers in this block, and Table 3's six weight heads print their maths markup raw as 'W_{1ia}' and so never typeset.

Two exhibits are country listings drawn as pictures rather than plots - p14's 'Figure 12' is a two-column, nine-row flag-and-name list whose columns open on an orphaned '·' where the header should stand, and p14's 'Figure 14' is a 6x3 flag grid under a separate two-row key with a clipped footnote - and both are recorded [geometry.family] 'table-as-figure' rather than 'other' because the exhibit is a name/number listing.

Figures 8, 9 and 7 on p9-p10 are the same packed-bubble construction re-run per industry, and Figures 20 and 22 are template-identical three-bar charts differing only in country class, so [geometry.family] 'scatter' and 'bar' each cover a repeated chart rather than a family of separate designs; the bubble charts print no size key at all, so their areas cannot be read as values.

Twenty-five of the fifty-five measured regions are the page-foot WeChat stamp at the same [448.3,721.7,583.1,789.1] corner block with 693 paths each, one on every page of the paper including the title page and the references page, so every excluded row is [geometry.family] 'background' and no exhibit region shares that block - unlike the previous paper in this block, no figure here is fused with its stamp.

The paper cites nine of its twenty-seven figures and one of its three tables: Figures 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 15 and 16 print with no mention at all, Tables 1 and 2 are never cited, and the pointers use three different spellings - 'Fig 1', 'Figure 12' and the text-layer broken 'F igure 23' - so [mention.style] keeps whichever form each row was cited in.

Figure 10 is cited on p11 and again nine pages later on p24, and Figures 21 and 22 are each cited once on p18 and then together in one sentence on p22, so those three rows carry [mention.count] 2 with a lead quote from the first page and a trail quote from the last.

Printed defects are pervasive and recorded per row rather than once: the unit string '(Unit: (in) hundred million US dollars)' repeats on Figures 5, 6 and 17 in broken English (and as '(in)10 thousand' on Figure 18), the in-figure titles of Figure 11 degrade to 'P1.r' and '64 F', Figure 19 misspells its own z axis as 'PaintingOutput', Figure 21 misspells Nepal as 'Nepol', Figure 13 renders Canada as 'Ganada', and Figures 12, 14 and 20 to 27 print either no axis title on both axes or none at all, which is why every one of those rows records [geometry.printed_numbers] false or a bare [geometry.legend] with no key.
